I tested with an AMD RX 580 2048SP and the crash only happens specifically with `D3D12` and `Forward+`. I had a slight different result from OP. In 4.6 dev 1 ~ 2 when i set the first `ReflectionProbe` node to `Always`, the preview starts to do a black blinking, spam an error and consumes all the VRAM/RAM if you keep reproducing the bug (even if i restart the editor with the `Always` mode will just reproduce this bug but not crash):
Error + Video ``` ERROR: Cannot clear texture because there's not enough room in the current frame's RENDER TARGET descriptors heap. Please increase the value of the rendering/rendering_device/d3d12/max_misc_descriptors_per_frame project setting. at: (drivers/d3d12/rendering_device_driver_d3d12.cpp:4210) ``` https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/509dcd85-9714-4f6b-abda-67cbd16575d9

On 4.6 dev 3 ~ 4 i had a crash but looks unrelated with this issue as crashed with `D3D12` no matter if `Forward+` or `Mobile` with an empty project.
And on 4.6 dev 5 onwards i have the same result: A crash without any error.

@SpockBauru Could you test if you're able to reproduce the crash with `D3D12 + Mobile` and with `Vulkan + Forward+`? I'll bisect between 4.5 stable and 4.6 dev 1 to find which PR started the first bug as seems to be related with the crash that OP has.

First time running the project, the screen stayed grey and only flashed what the camera would show when I pressed one of the keys for moving but immediately closed on its own. Afterwards, the game always closes immediately after running the project.

`Godot v4.6.rc2 - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory`

`v4.6.rc2.official [78c6632eb]`

The first error bisected to PR #110330 which caused the mentioned issues as was related there #112555. To fix #112555 another PR was made: #112916. 

As this PR was introduced in 4.6 dev 5 (the same version that started the crash without errors) i did a test compiling from the commit of the mentioned PR which cause the same crash as latest master, and reverting #112916 goes back to the error spam but without crash so seems to be the start point of this issue. 

In this case would be good if OP test if the MRP crash on 4.6 dev 5 with `D3D12 + Mobile` and in 4.6 dev 3 ~ 4 with an empty project and `D3D12` to confirm that is the same case as me.

CC @DarioSamo
This is not a D3D12 only problem, Vulkan also gives validation errors. It seems color attachments and depth stencils are getting mixed up in a render pass.
My testing on macOS above shows the same behaviour as on Windows so I also don't think it's platform related
This PR should address the issue, please test it when you can OP: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115299

> This PR should address the issue, please test it when you can OP: [#115299](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115299)

Tested the MRP on the Windows Artifact. No issues :D
Tested Forward+, Mobile and Compatibility renderes, each one on both d3d12 and Vulkan. No issues.

Also tested my personal project, random crashes stopped \o/

Thanks everyone! Awesome job!
